name: domain
label: Domain
help: The domain to track, like example.com. Enter only the domain, without https:// or a path.

name: name
label: Name
help: Display name. Defaults to the normalized domain.

name: timezone
label: Timezone
help: IANA timezone name such as Europe/Berlin or America/New_York. Defaults to the workspace timezone.

name: currency
label: Currency
help: 3-letter ISO 4217 code such as USD or EUR used for revenue. Defaults to the workspace currency.
